answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 32741 Country: India Title: Regarding Hair Transplantation (ref question 32694) Question: Just wanted to ask can i use my own hair for hair transplantation. (like i will shave off my head and give my own hair to the doctors to transplant it again on the upper portion of head) Answer ID: 32741 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1033/626/L=1432) It is not lawful to fix one's own hair on one's own head. ووصل الشعر بعشر الآدمى حرام سواء كان شعرها أو شعر غيرها (درمختار) وفى الشامي: لما فيه من التزوير (شامي: 9/535) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
